prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 78.0%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 91.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 30.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive Pet Reaction Sound Test Screen: Add a new screen after adoption certificate where users can preview audio samples and select sound feedback modes for their pet before desktop launch. (why: Adoption stage has a 78.0% conversion rate with high mean time (1017s); previewing pet audio builds user engagement before final waiting render.)
1: [home, hint] Desktop Tray Launch Readiness Check: Add a tray diagnostic status hint and notification badge on the waiting screen while background processes start. (why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to appear on desktop or app failing to open, while waiting step takes median 201s.)
2: [finish, copy] Pet Control Cheat Sheet Quick Reference Banner: Add explicit pet control instructions and desktop interaction shortcut notes to the final onboarding summary. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding pet visibility and desktop controls, leading to heavy drop-off at finish (64.8%).)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Photo Upload Alignment Diagnostic Screen: Insert a diagnostic checklist screen right after custom photo upload to confirm photo clarity and face bounding. (why: 3 support emails reported failed custom pet generations or distorted pets when converting photos into desktop companion models.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Recovery Account Check Diagnostic: Display an account sync indicator badge directly on sign_in to reassure returning users their saved pets remain safe. (why: 8 emails reported missing or reset pets after signing in again, and 2 reported sign-in stalls.)

scores.note: Adding a new screen adds friction with no direct support email backing.
Strong support evidence for tray readiness, though home step drop-off is already low.
Targets the highest drop-off step (finish) backed by 3 support emails with low copy cost.
Addresses photo generation issues mentioned in support, but requires a new screen.
High volume of support emails regarding missing pets during sign-in.
